verdict.rationale: Relay supports automated transfer rules between accounts by dollar amount or percentage (relay-docs-15) and cash-cushion/high-yield savings automation (relay-docs-6, relay-docs-24), corroborated by a community report of automatic money partitioning (relay-comm-1). However, there is no evidence of a specific 'low-balance alert' notification feature or threshold-triggered auto top-up logic. Missing for 10: explicit low-balance alert/notification capability, confirmation that transfers can be triggered by balance thresholds rather than just fixed schedules/percentages, independent verification of alerting reliability.
